description: Add loadSessionResponses() to sessions.ts and create GET /api/sessions/[id]/responses route. This is the backend foundation for both the per-user detail modal and the full group export.
steps: In web/lib/sessions.ts: Add interface SessionResponse { questionId: number; dimensionCode: string; score: number; timeSpentMs: number; answeredAt: number; }. Export it.

In web/lib/sessions.ts: Add async function loadSessionResponses(sessionId: string): Promise<SessionResponse[]> that queries 'SELECT question_id, dimension_code, score, time_spent_ms, answered_at FROM assessment_responses WHERE session_id = $1 ORDER BY question_id' using query() from @/lib/db. Wrap in try/catch returning [] on error (same pattern as listSessions()). Map rows: { questionId: Number(row.question_id), dimensionCode: String(row.dimension_code ?? ''), score: Number(row.score ?? 0), timeSpentMs: Number(row.time_spent_ms ?? 0), answeredAt: Number(row.answered_at ?? 0) }. Export it.

Create file web/app/api/sessions/[id]/responses/route.ts. Export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: { id: string } }). Call authorizeStaffRequest(request) from '@/lib/auth/staff'. If !auth.ok return NextResponse.json({ error: auth.error }, { status: 403 }). Otherwise call loadSessionResponses(params.id) and return NextResponse.json({ responses }). Use export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'; export const runtime = 'nodejs'; at top.

In web/tests/sessions-responses.test.ts (new file): write Vitest unit tests for loadSessionResponses() by mocking the query() function from '@/lib/db'. Test: (a) returns empty array when db throws, (b) maps row fields correctly to SessionResponse shape, (c) returns empty array when no rows. Follow the pattern used in web/tests/engine.test.ts or web/tests/read-access.test.ts for mocking.
acceptance_criteria: SessionResponse interface is exported from web/lib/sessions.ts
loadSessionResponses() is exported from web/lib/sessions.ts and follows the same lazy/safe pattern as listSessions()
Route returns { responses: SessionResponse[] } on success
All Vitest tests pass: npm run test -- --run
findings: Next.js 15 requires params to be typed as Promise<{ id: string }> in route handlers (not { id: string } directly). Fixed accordingly. All 156 tests pass, build clean.
